text.p: Tropical cyclone 08B, with winds of 63 mph, is located in the Bay of Bengal near 14.1N/88.0E and is moving off to the west at 6 mph. This system is expected to take a more nrothwesterly track over the next few days and make landfall somewhere in northeastern India sometime on either late Tuesday or Wednesday. Moderate to heavy rain, gusty winds, localized flooding, and mudsldes can be expected as this storm moves onshore.
Tropical Depression 40W has dissipated over the South Pacific Ocean, but a few lingering showers and thunderstorms may accompany the remnants of the storm. Thisa should be no problem to shipping.
No other disturbances at this time.
